common.description: Common UI strings used throughout the application

loading.description: Loading indicator text shown while content is being fetched.

error.description: Generic error message shown when something goes wrong.

retry.description: Button text to retry a failed action.

about_meditation.description: Primary navigation link opening the "About Meditation" knowledge section.

learn_more.description: Navigation link to educational content and resources.

come_meditate.description: Call-to-action navigation link inviting users to start meditating.

languages.description: Label for the language selector in the header/navigation.

classes_near_me.description: Action link inviting users to find in-person meditation classes near their location (frontend: "Classes near me").

info.description: Heading for the footer's "Info" column, which lists informational pages (about, contact, privacy, etc.) (frontend: "Info").

page_tags.description: Category labels for page tags, shown as pills/facets on article and content-index listings; mirrors the frontend `PAGE_TAG_LABELS`

errors.description: User-facing error messages shown when content cannot be played

meditation_missing_audio.description: Error shown on a meditation page when the meditation has no playable audio source (frontend: "This meditation is missing a required audio URL.").

lecture_missing_video.description: Error shown on a lecture page when the lecture has no playable video source (frontend: "This lecture is missing a playable video source.").
